# Snyder's Outdoor Solutions
> Licensed tree service based in Hagerstown, MD. Residential tree removal, emergency response, storm cleanup, trimming, stump grinding, and lot clearing across the Tri-State area (Maryland, Pennsylvania, West Virginia). Owner-operated. Free estimates. 24/7 emergency tree removal.

Phone: (301) 288-1677
Primary markets: Hagerstown MD, Greencastle PA, Waynesboro PA, Frederick MD, Martinsburg WV.
Contact for quotes and emergency dispatch: https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/contact
Outdoor / non-tree services are not currently offered.

## Tree services
- [Tree Removal](https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/tree-services/tree-removal): Safe residential tree removal with cleanup
- [Emergency Tree Removal](https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/tree-services/emergency-tree-removal): 24/7 response for trees on houses, cars, or driveways
- [Storm Damage Cleanup](https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/tree-services/storm-damage-cleanup): Fallen branches, uprooted trees, debris hauling
- [Tree Trimming & Pruning](https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/tree-services/tree-trimming-pruning): Health and clearance pruning
- [Stump Grinding](https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/tree-services/stump-grinding): Stump removal after tree work
- [Lot & Land Clearing](https://snydersoutdoorsolutions.com/tree-services/lot-land-clearing): Brush removal and building-site prep
